why: Two named products, two obligations. ODbL 1.0 is the licence the Protomaps basemap carries as a Produced Work; osm.org/copyright is where OpenStreetMap states the credit and share-alike requirements a user of its data must meet. Both are recorded here so a reader can tell a fetched text from a remembered one.
